# trefolio

> The European investor's portfolio tracker — EU tax reports, stock screener, AI insights, and net worth tracking in 35 languages.

## What is trefolio?

trefolio is a web-based portfolio tracker built for European retail investors. It offers tax reports for 17 countries (Germany, France, Spain, Netherlands, Italy, UK, US, Switzerland, Austria, Portugal, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Poland) with AI Tax Assistant, a stock screener covering 600+ stocks, a Holdings explorer to rank your own positions by P/E, yield, and weight (ask Warren about a highlighted figure; AI-generated, not investment advice), net worth tracking (real estate, savings, pensions), broker auto-sync via SnapTrade (20+ brokerages), 14 broker CSV import formats, AI-powered analysis in your native language, dividend tracking and projections, performance metrics (TTWROR, XIRR, Sharpe, Max Drawdown), portfolio simulator (backtesting, what-if, stress testing), and 4 dashboard themes. Available in 35 European languages with 21-currency support.

## Pricing

- Free (Folio): Limited holdings and AI usage, real-time quotes, charts, growth projection, broker import, earnings calendar for your holdings
- Trefolio (paid — see /landing for current launch vs regular monthly/annual EUR pricing): One subscription includes all premium features: higher limits, tax reports (17 countries), stock screener, portfolio simulator, net worth tracking, fundamentals, intelligence, economic indicators, SnapTrade broker sync, all dashboard themes, IPO calendar, WhatsApp/device alerts, and more

## Company analysis

Public stock pages at `/analisis/{TICKER}` show fundamentals, technicals, news, and an AI narrative for researched tickers. Live quotes refresh on each visit; the broader company report is cached for one day and rebuilt when a visitor opens an expired ticker. Informational only — not investment advice.
## Trefolio ecosystem

- Will (AI notes): https://will.trefolio.com — Telegram-first open-source AI note-taking assistant (MIT).
- Clara (personal finance): https://clara.trefolio.com — Chat-first open-source AI expense assistant with public and per-user MCP servers (MIT).
